1851	  local max_cost_usd=""
1852	  local jobs=1
1853	  local positional=()

1857	      --profile)        profile_csv="${2:?--profile requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
1858	      --bench-set)      bench_set_csv="${2:?--bench-set requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;

1860	      --out)            out="${2:?--out requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;

1862	      --retry-invalid)  retry_invalid=1; shift ;;

1867	      --)               shift; positional+=("$@"); break ;;
1868	      -*)               die "unknown flag: $1" ;;
1869	      *)                positional+=("$1"); shift ;;
1870	    esac
1871	  done
1872	
1873	  local sub=""

1875	    sub="${positional[0]}"

1877

1881	    harness-adapters)  cmd_harness_adapters ;;
